title: Knowledge base family
description: The sibling knowledge bases that share this KB's format, and which topics each one owns.

self.description: True for this repo's own entry.

role.description: reference = owns the family format and is the hub siblings track and read directives from (decision 0007); hub = older name for a KB that owns knowledge shared by all; member = a sibling; observer = a private layer that reads the family and isn't watched (no repo).
